shown.because: Different targets can need different methods; each is assessed on its own
source: AFS ref D05 'target variables still need definition'

shown.because: Raman gives a molecular fingerprint for glucose, acetate or lactate in the same reactor

questions.text: Which variables exactly should be reported, each with its own reference measurement?
Can deposits form at the probe window, and how is the line cleaned (CIP, temperature, chemicals)?
Which physical and formulation changes occur between runs (temperature, texture, particle size, air bubbles, recipe)?
What temperature, pressure and flow occur at the measurement point?
Which independent reference method and sampling time can be used?
What concentration range, accuracy and response time must the measurement meet?

lab_checks: Check on representative samples whether fluorescence background swamps the Raman signal.
